no-db-in-presentation.description: Q1 (ADR-0003): the Presentation layer (studio/app UI) must not access the database directly. Move queries into studio/lib/data and call them from a server action or route.

externals-behind-data-layer.description: Q3 (ADR-0003): external SDKs (Supabase, Claude) belong in the Data-Source layer (studio/lib/data), not in UI screens or Domain logic.
